\sketch Use the reduced-length and reduced-volume identities, the maximum principle, and the cited surgery estimates; the resulting barriers give the stated bound. ↗ lem:kl-noncollapsed-pointed-limits-hyperbolic-noncollapsing-lemma

Put $\overline{R} \: = \: \lim _{t \rightarrow \infty } \hat{R}(t)$.
